  -- Credit memos
  SELECT 
    c.load_id,
    c.cr_dt AS doc_dt,
    c.curr_cd,
    c.cr_amt AS amt,
    -1 AS sign
  FROM bil_cr_memo c
  WHERE c.cr_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'

  -- Canceled load fees
  SELECT 
    f.load_id,
    f.fee_dt AS doc_dt,
    f.curr_cd,
    f.cust_fee_amt AS amt,
    1 AS sign
  FROM bil_canc_fee f
